question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing benchwarmer, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing striker, Eve is playing cheerleader, Fred is playing left winger, and Gertrude is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) benchwarmer
(B) center midfielder
(C) right winger
(D) striker
(E) cheerleader
(F) left winger
(G) right back
solution:
Positions in each row are ordered by player: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: benchwarmer, center midfielder, right winger, striker, cheerleader, left winger, right back
1. Claire and Bob swap: benchwarmer, right winger, center midfielder, striker, cheerleader, left winger, right back
2. Claire and Bob swap: benchwarmer, center midfielder, right winger, striker, cheerleader, left winger, right back
3. Dave and Alice swap: striker, center midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, cheerleader, left winger, right back
4. Claire and Gertrude swap: striker, center midfielder, right back, benchwarmer, cheerleader, left winger, right winger
5. Alice and Eve swap: cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, benchwarmer, striker, left winger, right winger
6. Fred and Bob swap: cheerleader, left winger, right back, benchwarmer, striker, center midfielder, right winger
7. Alice and Eve swap: striker, left winger, right back, benchwarmer, cheerleader, center midfielder, right winger
Claire is playing right back, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
